name: Second Self
tagline: A digital twin that runs as a parallel user on your Mac, learns how you write and acts for you.

awards: Best Use of Hermes -- Nous Research

problem: The team wanted an agent that can be you while you are elsewhere.
solution: Runs as a separate native macOS session with computer use, browser use and connectors, and a voice and writing profile learned from your emails, posts and files.
demo_moment: Team-described: the twin answers an email in your style while you work.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Personal AI Agent” and “Best Use of Hermes -- Nous Research” among 212 submissions.
Runs natively alongside you rather than in the cloud.

lessons: Isolating the agent in its own session makes delegation safe to demo.
